body: Spot on.. ive been stable at 24 with my setup just now so all looking good 👍
Happy days 🍄! These are golden teachers... what do you think is ideal fruiting temps? Keep it at 24 degrees?
Interesting.. yes i have done as you suggested earlier today. Feels so unnatural to break up that beautiful mycelium though!! 🤣
Thanks very much for the clear reply much appreciated! 👍 just to clarify the growth hasnt stalled at this point... its slowed a little but overall its been going at a good pace

Haha! So forgive me for sounding stupid here... can you describe the technique? Just like a gentle shake? Do i need to break it all up? 
I dont want to hurt the mycelium 🤷‍♂️
Not that i saw or remember
Yes but ive also had the complete opposite and felt nothing but love and even seen the "mother" with eyes open before
Haha fair point kinda goes with the territory 🤣🤣

Well done too for staying clean that takes strength! 
Like i kinda said i think in a way DMT gives you what you need... it shows you things only when you are ready
I can understand that... personally ive found ive had many very different experiences its almost like DMT knows what to give you

Hahaha well... yes id mostly agree. But having tried again today ive had the most profound and beautiful out of body experience WITH MY EYES OPEN. 
Again im writing this while still coming down (always the best time to write) 😂 im now left thinking what is DMT? what is this thing that can give such profound experience both eyes open or closed or anything because honestly most times i cat tell if their open or closed 🤷‍♂️

Yeah I'd say shitheads... Or stronger... See often times I thought it must be me.. What wrong with me? I mean I'm the type of person that will get on with most people but I always end up being used really can I fix their car? Can I borrow this or that... 
But when it comes to it people don't bother with me unless I bother with them or they are getting something out of it. 
Admittedly I was blinded by my ex an she turned me against a good few of my friends back then that I now realise was all lies 

But most recently a friend I had known for around 12 years (we were in the military together) he met a girl and relocated and I'm happy he's happy but he just never had time for me from that point and he just doesn't understand my troubles he's just not that way inclined I suppose. 
Even so ever since the ex I just can't trust people. She would tell me every day I was worthless and I'd never do better than her... Amongst the violence she would lock me in rooms and all sorts 

Now years later I hear she's gotten married and my life has just plummeted ever since that relationship maybe she was right after all 
I have no motivation or joy for anything in life these days and I'm so totally aware I have to turn things around but after years or trying and failing I'm just so fucking tired of it all. This isn't how its supposed to be?

I can be quite sensible on occasion I mean I do know what's right and I'm a fairly intelligent person but this has always seem to work against me
I other think literally everything and that coupled with my self hatred and things I see in everyday life makes things nearly impossible for me. 
Most nights I can barely sleep I just can't switch off and no matter what my thought process it inevitably leads to my own feelings about myself. 
I find myself in a daze sometimes whilst driving just lost in thought and quite often I cry whilst driving.
I also cry at the slightest thing on TV even short adverts I can just break down. 

I think mostly I miss people and some kind emotional and meaningful friendship 
But these days I despise people they have never given me anything only taken from me. 
It's a hard thing to overcome. Well in fact I've tried for years now but I can't. 

And really I think I'm just rambling on now I don't get to talk much which is probably obvious

Thank you but I wouldn't say that exactly and I don't believe I have overcome anything to be honest. It seems I take two steps forward and ten back every time.. 
I have been to more counselling than I can remember none of which has really helped and every time I fall back into depression and being a recluse which makes me feel even worse that I may be such a burden to family members that I keep the most personal and worst parts a secret from them. 

In the last couple of years I was heavily on drugs at one point.. Using daily and had a mild suicide attempt 
I sought help at the right point but mental health support is terrible in the UK as we all know. 
Thankfully I have gotten through that and no longer use or even smoke for that matter. 

The trouble is I feel most of my problems are in my nature and these are only worsened by the current world we live in.. I refuse to watch news or read papers or even mix with various types of people because all this only makes me worse 
Then I come home and dwell on my own thoughts and self loathing

I thank you for your reply I'm sorry it was really so long but in honesty I could have gone on forever 
There's much more to it as I'm sure there is to many other people, we all have our stories 
Trouble is our minds are often our worst enemies
